OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT

Nimbus Data Systems, Inc. ("Company") is pleased to offer you ("Employee") the position of Senior Software Engineer, reporting to the Director of Engineering.

1. Position and Duties. Employee shall serve in the role described above and perform such duties as are customarily associated with that position or as reasonably assigned by the Company.

2. Compensation. Employee's starting base salary shall be $138,000 per year, paid in accordance with the Company's standard payroll schedule, subject to applicable withholdings.

3. Signing Bonus. Employee shall receive a signing bonus of $10,000, payable within thirty (30) days of the start date. If Employee resigns or is terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of the start date, Employee shall repay the full signing bonus to the Company within thirty (30) days of separation.

4. At-Will Employment. Employment with the Company is at-will, meaning either Employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice.

5. Non-Compete. For a period of twelve (12) months following termination of employment for any reason, Employee shall not, directly or indirectly, provide services to any business that competes with the Company within the United States.

5.1. Employee acknowledges that this restriction is reasonable in scope and necessary to protect the Company's legitimate business interests, and that violation entitles the Company to injunctive relief in addition to monetary damages.

6. Confidentiality and Assignment of Inventions. Employee agrees to keep confidential all proprietary information of the Company and assigns to the Company all rights in any invention, work product, or intellectual property created during employment that relates to the Company's business.

7. Arbitration. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this offer or Employee's employment shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration, and Employee waives the right to a jury trial or to participate in a class action.

8. Benefits. Employee shall be eligible to participate in the Company's health, dental, and vision insurance plans, and its 401(k) plan, subject to the terms of those plans, beginning on the first day of the month following sixty (60) days of employment.

9. Paid Time Off. Employee shall accrue paid time off at a rate of fifteen (15) days per year, accruing monthly, with a maximum accrual cap of thirty (30) days.

10. Background Check. This offer is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and verification of Employee's eligibility to work in the United States.

11. Relocation. If Employee relocates for this position, the Company shall reimburse reasonable relocation expenses up to $5,000, provided Employee remains employed for at least twelve (12) months, or shall repay a prorated portion of the reimbursement upon earlier voluntary departure.

12. Entire Agreement. This offer letter, once signed, constitutes the entire agreement between Employee and the Company regarding the terms described herein and supersedes any prior discussions or representations.
